crossRefs.note: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
“Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in…
“Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at…
You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come…

translations.web: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
translations.bsb: For all their tables are covered with vomit; there is not a place without filth.
translations.kjv: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place
translations.asv: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
